messages:
elaine: Customer says SLO cards get noisy when multiple notify rules expand. Proposal: show a single compact 'Notify' line and let hover/expand reveal details so dashboards stay tidy.

matt: Sounds good. Is this only a UI change or do we need new API fields? We can't break routing/quota logic.

elaine: Prefer minimal API churn. Idea: add `notify_summary` (string) and `notify_telemetry` (smallish string/json blob) to /slo-status, leave `notify_policy` intact. UI reads summary by default.

jia: Telemetry owners worry about losing which rule fired. Can we include a tiny last-fired tag inline like "Pager • fired 15m ago (c4f2)" so triage still works?

kevin: Platform can emit two light fields: summary + telemetry tag with truncated rule hash (4 chars) and suppression flag. That limits cardinality. We'll also server-side sample verbose emissions.

ux-sara: UX: primary card must be max 2 rows. Hover shows suppression reason, owner, and link to "view raw policy". Use chips for urgency and a gray "Suppressed" badge when quiet-window applies.

opsbot: Canary window scheduled 08:30 UTC tomorrow.

matt: I'll draft the API PR and add feature flags: `slo_notify_compact` and `notify_verbose` so telemetry can opt in. Add "view raw" in hover for SREs.

elaine: Action list: matt -> PR + flags; kevin -> telemetry plan + cardinality mitigation; jia -> sampling thresholds; ux-sara -> hover spec. Small-tenant canary first.

matt: PR link when ready. :+1:
